conditions.displayName: The whim-purge Cloud Run Job logged an error

documentation.content: The hourly retention purge (Cloud Run Job `whim-purge`) logged an error: records past their keep period may not be deleted. At most one email per hour. See its recent runs with `gcloud run jobs executions list --job whim-purge --region us-east4 --limit 5` and its lines with `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="whim-purge"' --freshness 1d` (docs/deploy.md, Firestore stores: Retention purges).
